commitResults.messageTitle: Move Java classes into dobby package
commitResults.messageBody:
Java classes use the default package, which does not satisfy the
project's Java coding standard and leaves the package structure unclear.

Move Dobby and Task into the lowercase dobby package, preserve their
behavior, and update the README path for the new source location.

Java contributors need a project-specific style reference for future
changes.

Add the SE-EDU Java standard as a local skill and mandate it in the
project agent instructions so new code and refactors use consistent
packages, layout, imports, and documentation.

Git contributions need a project-specific reference for commit and
branch conventions.

Add the SE-EDU Git standard as a local skill and mandate it in the
project agent instructions so future commits use focused messages and
meaningful branch names.

Dobby's entry point currently combines the welcome banner, command loop, dispatch, parsing, and task storage. Extract the session workflow into focused helpers so each method stays at a readable level of abstraction.

Preserve the existing task hierarchy and console behavior while making future command changes easier to locate and verify.
Preserve a dedicated merge commit for the Level-5 deliverable.

Dobby currently mixes user interaction with command and task logic.\n\nExtract input, welcome, response, and task-list rendering into Ui so later extraction steps can focus on parsing and task management without changing observable behavior.

Command behavior currently lives in Dobby's loop, making future command extraction harder.\n\nIntroduce a reusable Command contract and move the bye response into ExitCommand so command-specific behavior can be migrated incrementally without changing the existing console behavior.

Dobby currently passes a raw task array and count through its command logic, coupling task storage to the application loop.\n\nIntroduce TaskList to own task collection operations and update persistence and display code to use it, preserving the existing command behavior while preparing the command hierarchy for shared task state.

Dobby currently discovers its storage and task state inside the command loop, which limits the command objects it can delegate to.\n\nGive Dobby explicit Ui, Storage, and TaskList fields and make Storage instance-based so commands can receive the application dependencies they need.

Command parsing and execution still reside in Dobby, so adding new commands requires editing the application loop.\n\nMove command creation into Parser and migrate list, add, mark, unmark, and exit behavior into Command subclasses that share the task, UI, and storage context. Keep existing console behavior unchanged.
